notes: Direct custom connector is the default; Agent flow wrapper is optional.
No automatic push notification is implemented.
Do not interpret an installation link as permission to use an agent or its source library.

CreateDraft.inputBinding: Use confirmed topic variables, not AI-filled confirmation.

UploadTemplate.inputBinding: Bind file_name and original binary content_base64 through a File-input topic/flow. Never fill these with AI.

ApplyTemplate.inputBinding: Bind owned completed job_id and uploaded template_id after an explicit user request. Do not add redundant confirmation when intent and target are clear.

aiPromptBlueprints.status: manual configuration blueprints only; not imported or activated by this repository
requiredOutputHandling: Configure every prompt for JSON output using the schema in its blueprint.
Validate prompt output before using it as a tool input.
Never allow a prompt to invent a slide ID or a template layout name.
Keep the validated evidence snippet, selection reason, risks and coverage gap in topic variables for user review and audit.

smartAiWorkflow.status: design blueprint only: configure prompts, variables, loops, validation and tools manually in an approved Copilot Studio tenant
smartAiWorkflow.goal: Use Copilot AI for storyline, query expansion, evidence-grounded reranking and constrained layout choice while Python performs deterministic PPTX operations.

steps.validation: JSON schema plus section slide counts must sum to target_slide_count; no source IDs are accepted from this prompt.

actions.action: Union all query results and de-duplicate by exact slideId without rewriting candidate fields.

actions.input: Current section goal, requested count, constraints and Topic.uniqueCandidates

checks: Every selected slide_id occurs exactly once in Topic.uniqueCandidates.
Every evidence_snippet is copied from the matching title or snippet.
Selected count does not exceed the current section's requested slide count.
actions.onFailure: Do not persist or draft. Rerun with the validation error or ask the user to choose from the grounded candidate list.

steps.output: Topic.validatedSelections with exact IDs, evidence, reasons, risks and coverage gaps

input.title: Topic.presentationBrief.title
input.sections: Section titles, canonical English queries, requested counts and goals from validated prompt output
input.template_id: omit on the smart-layout route; apply the selected template after source draft creation

input.sections: Full section list with the exact validated reranked slide IDs in output order; retain selection reasons in topic audit variables

steps.note: The initial PlanPresentation search is deterministic. This revision is required for the prompt reranking to control the saved selection.

input.slide_ids: Exact ordered slide IDs from Topic.rerankedPlan

steps.note: Structural analysis only; picture count is not image relevance or visual understanding.

steps.when: The user supplied or requested a PowerPoint template
steps.topic: Upload and apply a PowerPoint template
steps.output: Topic.template with exact templateId and layoutNames

steps.input: Presentation goal, exact Topic.template.layoutNames, Topic.slideAnalyses and validated selection reasons
steps.validation: Every slide ID must occur in Topic.slideAnalyses and every layout name must occur in Topic.template.layoutNames.
steps.fallback: If connector fields cannot accept validated overrides, retain decisions as review guidance and explicitly state they were not applied.

steps.content: Show the story order, exact source file and page, copied evidence, selection reason, date uncertainty, coverage gap, structural analysis and proposed template action for every selected slide.

steps.required: User explicitly approves the current planId, revision, exact source order and requested template treatment.

steps.onPending: Wait for an explicit later check; do not call template processing against an incomplete job.
steps.onCompleted: Continue to template application when requested, otherwise use this as the final job.

steps.when: Topic.template exists and the source draft is completed

input.layout_overrides: Deterministically map decisions[].output_order to layout_overrides[].output_slide and decisions[].layout_name to layout_overrides[].layout_name; discard action, rationale and review fields

steps.note: The backend assigns the exact chosen template layout and proportionally scales source geometry. A prompt action value of reflow is a human-review recommendation; semantic reflow is not executed.

input.job_id: Topic.finalJob.jobId when a template was applied, otherwise Topic.sourceDraftJob.jobId

steps.onCompleted: Continue to layout checks; do not deliver early.

steps.note: Report off-canvas, overlap and density heuristics as warnings, not proof of visual quality.

steps.content: Return only the real completed webUrl, source map, selection audit, template decision status, layout warnings and the need for desktop PowerPoint review.

failureBoundaries: No prompt output can authorize confirmed=true.
No unvalidated slide ID or layout name reaches a file-writing tool.
No image relevance claim is made from structural object counts.
No clean heuristic report is described as pixel-perfect design.
Prompt files and this workflow do not configure or publish a live tenant.

steps.note: Guard against empty System.Activity.Attachments. If multiple files arrive, establish which is the template.

steps.identity: Same end-user requester as CreateDraft and ApplyTemplate

steps.onCompleted: Return new webUrl and relevant warnings; retain original draft link.

templateWorkflow.validation: PPTX/POTX binary attachment support must be tested in the selected agent harness and actual published channel; backend support does not imply channel support.

v2StorylineWorkflow.status: design blueprint only: must be configured manually in an approved Copilot Studio tenant
v2StorylineWorkflow.trigger: User asks for a multi-section presentation or for revisions to a saved plan

steps.prompt: Propose 2–8 audience-specific sections with title, query, estimated slides, and goals. Do not invent facts or source IDs.

steps.content: Present section structure, exact source slide IDs, file, page, report period, gap flags, and plan revision. Explain any uncertainties.

steps.when: User requests a new section, focus, order, dates or template

inputs.sections: full revised section list with exact source slide IDs

steps.required: User explicitly approves the precise current planId, revision, source order and template. No call on refusal.

steps.trigger: only after explicit confirmation of latest plan

steps.onPending: Inform user of queued/running state; check on request.
steps.onCompleted: Return authenticated SharePoint webUrl with warnings and sourceMap; no invented link.

CreateDraftFromPlan.inputBinding: Bound from confirmed topic variables only

RevisePresentationPlan.inputBinding: Bound to current plan revision; never silently overwrite concurrent edits

boundaries: No AI-generated factual slides in V2.
Existing template apply is limited; no claim of automatic full redesign.
There is no dedicated semantic vector service; LLM generates search queries.
Plan data stores approved slide references, not newly invented facts.
No tenant publication or connector import is performed by this file.
